title: Tencent open-sources Hy4 flash GGUF weights; smallest reportedly runs on 64 GB Mac mini
summary: Tencent Hunyuan has released GGUF quantized weights for its 224-billion-parameter Hy4 flash model through its AngelSlim compression toolkit. The original weights are about 410.27 GiB, while the smallest IQ2-AH quantized version is 125.73 GiB, roughly 30% of the original, and is reported to run on a 64 GB Mac mini using the Strata offload framework. The release report cites 89 tokens/s at 10K context on a 48 GB VRAM device and 47 tokens/s at 32K context with Q3\_K on an M5 Max with 128 GB, plus a score gap of no more than 0.4 points versus the original on DeepSWE v1.1. These figures come from a Telegram aggregator summary and are not independently verified; no methodology was provided.
